name: Roast Pork
source:
The head of the Over Heaven Society.
For a while, he was running a restaurant after he returned to a more formal life, but when the heads of the society, MingFung and Jeff, died one after another, he was dragged out and appointed as the head of the Over Heaven Society.
At the time, he had been secretly planning to restore the Over Heaven Society to its former status as a solid organization, and he had been discussing this with Sylvia.
He forms a historic alliance with the Red Flower society and the HH brothers.
